title: Yoga Retreat Greece

hero_image.alt: The group stopped on the clifftop trail from Fira to Oia, Santorini, Greece

intro: Looking for the best yoga retreat in Greece?! Then join us in Santorini for an EPIC adventure filled with soulful yoga, delicious Greek food and wines, breathtaking scenery and beaches, a stunning hike and tons of time to relax by the pool or catch up on some reading in this Grecian paradise. Santorini is known for its breathtaking sunsets and ocean views but we show you a side of the island that is so much more than that. It’s not all honeymoons and romantic getaways!
about_body: We have been leading yoga retreats in Santorini for many years and leaving with tons of amazing memories and new friends! Come experience this amazing Greek Island adventure to the most picturesque island in the beautiful Cyclades of the Aegean archipelago.

Of course Santorini is known for its breathtaking sunsets and ocean views but our retreats includes so much more. Incredible yoga practices with spectacular views from our private luxury villa will start off your days, followed by a bit of hiking, amazing food, delicious local wines, and beach hopping round out your days. We venture out in a fabulous catamaran out for an afternoon into evening sunset cruise finding the best hidden spots along the beautiful edges of Santorini with a bit of local wine, some music, and the ocean breeze to move us along. Add on to your week with a pampering healing massage, a cooking demonstration, or simply relax around the villa by one of the pools or explore the village of Pyrgos by foot just outside your door.
However you plan to enjoy your days on retreat we are thrilled to have you along for the ride!
includes: 6 nights accommodations in luxury villa atop Santorini with swimming pools and caldera views
Yoga daily as per the itinerary
Opening & Closing dinners plus one dinner out on the town (2 glasses of wine included with dinners)
Guided Southern Island Day tour including Lighthouse, Aktrotiri Ruins site & beach hopping; Lunch included at our favorite spot
Seaside wine tasting of Santorini’s best whites
Catamaran Sunset Cruise w/ late lunch, swimming and cocktails
Hike the famous trail from Fira to Oia with incredible views as an option
Walking Food & Drink Tour of some of the islands best treats
Shared Airport Transfers to and from JTR*
Free time to explore the island and beaches on your own
not_included: Airfare into JTR (Thira Airport in Santorini)
Extras like massages, shopping, drinking water, alcohol and taxis
Gratuities for villa staff, guides, drivers, boat captains, etc
If you need a private ride outside of these shuttle times please send us your flight itinerary and we can arrange this for you at an additional cost.
not_included_footnote: Shuttle pick up from JTR airport at 3pm on arrival day. Departure from the villa on final morning at 9am.

text: Accommodations in our own strikingly beautiful villa featuring breathtaking views of the island and the Aegean Sea. We will take a full property of luxury villas for ourselves. Swimming pools and lounge chairs, fully equipped kitchens, and quiet reading nooks are available throughout the property.

Full breakfast will be offered daily in our main dining area. Traditional Greek fruits, cheeses, pastries, eggs, and coffee will be among the choices daily. Choose to create your own lunches and dinners in these lovely kitchens and lounge by the pool for the afternoon.

Rooms are offered as private queens, semi-private queens (2 level accommodations with loft upstairs), and Shared accommodations. Each villa has its own bathrooms and some rooms have en-suite bathrooms with its own charms and unique details.
Our yoga retreat offers spectacular accommodations on Greece’s most picturesque island in the Cyclades! You’ll be so glad you joined us for this truly amazing retreat experience.

faqs.question: Do you accept bitcoin?
answer: In addition to credit card payments we also accept wire transfers, Zelle and Bitcoin. Please inquire for more details.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
answer: All payments are 100% non refundable and non-transferable. We recommend that you buy trip cancellation insurance immediately upon making your initial deposit to cover any travel hiccups or complications that may arise between now and the time of your retreat. No exceptions are possible so please cover your trip by connecting with an insurance company that offers the right policy for you.

faqs.question: What happens if my travel plans change?
answer: There are no refunds as per our cancellation policies. We highly recommend that all of our guests secure a quality travel insurance that will cover them for any event which may cause a change of travel plans, including personal health issues or personal situations in general which may affect travel plans.

faqs.question: Are flight delays or cancellations covered?
answer: Not by us: transportation delays, cancellations or changes due to strikes, labor disputes, or lockouts from airlines, boats, ferries or any type of transportation are among the events we recommend covering with travel insurance.

faqs.question: Where can I find the full terms & conditions?
answer: The full terms and conditions are published at https://yogaadventuresworldwide.com/termsandconditions/ . By submitting payments toward your retreat you accept them.

booking.deposit_instructions: Deposits of $1,000usd are due to secure your space in the retreat. Please check availability with us for accommodations before making your deposit.
booking.balance_note: The balance of your retreat (minus your $1,000usd initial deposit) is due 90 days prior to arrival. All details with instructions for settling up will be emailed to you three months prior to the retreat.
booking.roommate_note: Roommates should book together. If you would like to share a room and do not have a roommate we will provide one for you if possible. In the case that there is no one to share a room we ask that you take a private room instead.
